dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Haha! It was the right call to come here during the festival. You just can't beat the festive cheer here in the city!

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I've heard that the Moonchase Festival used to be celebrated for very different reasons in the past. Something about the adepti's rituals, I believe.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: But I don't think that what it's about now — gathering together and admiring the moon — is half bad, either!

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I'm sure that the adepti, too, would be gladdened to see everyone enjoying themselves.
